increment_threshold.definition: blank-corrected fraction mass divided by cumulative blank-corrected mass is less than 0.010

maximum_cycles.action: MAXIMUM_REACHED_NOT_QUALIFIED; retain every fraction and no I_ref qualification

blank_handling.definition: subtract paired blank; negative corrected mass retained raw and uses zero only for stopping statistic

lod_loq.definition: below LOD contributes zero only to stopping statistic; detected below LOQ is censored and cannot qualify; above LOQ uses quantified mass and uncertainty

precision_floor.definition: fraction above LOQ but below validated precision range cannot qualify

independent_stop_action.definition: continue physical cycles until both analytes stop or maximum; freeze earlier analyte endpoint at its qualifying cycle while retaining later fractions

uncertainty.definition: propagate blank calibration fraction and cumulative covariance; stopping classification uncertainty is retained
